title: Audit
description: One row of llm-wiki/states/audit_log.jsonl — the trail of every write run and every denial (housamkak v3 §17.4, spec.md `### Ledger rows`). run_id = run_ + 12 hex of sha256(actor · verb · timestamp · the input hashes joined by comma · views_before) — the same id stamped on every ledger row the run appends, so this row and its rows join on it. outcome distinguishes a run that changed the views (ok), one that ran and changed nothing (unchanged), one the policy refused (denied, with detail naming the reason), and one that raised (failed); appended and pages count what the run wrote, and views_before/views_after are the sha256 over the sorted per-file sha256 of the five views (null when states/ is absent), letting audit --check prove the ledgers and the views agree.

run_id.description: run_ + 12 hex of sha256(actor · verb · timestamp · the input hashes · views_before). Content-derived, so re-running the same inputs at the same moment never collides silently.

actor.description: The identity the run resolved, either from --actor/LLM_WIKI_ACTOR or the human-only --by.

role.description: The actor's role at governance.json lookup time — actors[actor], else the actor's own prefix.

args.description: The verb's own arguments, in the order given on the command line.

inputs.description: The files the run read to decide what to append, each hashed at read time so a later dispute can confirm which bytes drove the run.

appended.description: How many rows the run added to each ledger — zero everywhere on a denied or failed run.

pages.description: Which rendered pages the run touched — empty on every engine run; the renderer's own audit row names what render wrote or removed.

views_before.description: sha256 over the sorted per-file sha256 of the five views before the run; null when states/ is absent (the very first run).

views_after.description: The same hash taken after the run; equal to views_before on an unchanged, denied, or failed outcome.

detail.description: null on ok and unchanged; the denial or failure message otherwise.
